text: Please can someone help me, I'm looking after my granddaughter Ella tonight, she is 4 months old, and I'm frightened I'm missing something. Her breathing isn't right. It's very quick, much quicker than when I watched her the other night, and when she breathes in the skin underneath her ribs pulls right in, like a little dip each time. Every so often there's a funny grunting noise at the end of a breath too. I've had four of my own and I don't remember ever seeing a baby breathe like that. The other thing that's worrying me is her nappy. I changed her at about half past nine this morning and it's been bone dry every time I've checked since, and it's now gone eleven at night. I've kept offering her the bottle. My daughter is on a night shift and I can't get hold of her, so it's just me. I keep telling myself I'm being an old worrier but I can't shake the feeling. Should I be taking her somewhere now, tonight? I'll do whatever you say.
